page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn5i family, virtualized via the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated physical CPU cores with 1.0 thread per core, providing 2 vCPUs. The system is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance integrates a single NVIDIA P4 graphics processing unit with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage must be provisioned via external network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is limited to a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile represents an entry-level GPU acceleration tier. The combination of a single NVIDIA P4 GPU and 2 dedicated vCPUs makes this instance appropriate for lightweight GPU-accelerated tasks such as small-scale inference, video transcoding, or basic parallel computing development. The lack of local storage and modest network bandwidth are key architectural tradeoffs to consider when planning deployments.
